main_upgrade.summary: Morning LIVE claims now require the public publication receipt to bind the exact canonical snapshot, mirror source commit, Netlify content deploy and required UI checks.
main_upgrade.why: A READY deploy or matching timestamp can be ambiguous when a newer mirror commit exists or when the visible alias points at a receipt-only deploy. Receipt binding prevents false LIVE claims and makes publication evidence snapshot-specific.

portfolio.strongest_positive_change: The canonical and mirror snapshots were already identical, and Morning verification now requires receipt-bound proof before any LIVE claim.
portfolio.largest_risk: Provider/live proof and observed business KPI sources remain incomplete across several active projects.

metric_impact.after: Receipt-bound snapshot, mirror commit, content deploy and UI proof
metric_impact.evidence: Morning automation contract and production receipt schema

metric_impact.before: LIVE rule did not explicitly distinguish receipt deploy from content deploy
metric_impact.after: LIVE rule distinguishes and binds both deploy roles

evening_verification_questions: Does the public receipt snapshot_timestamp equal 2026-07-18T07:35:00+02:00?
Does the receipt content_deploy.source_commit_sha identify the latest brain-management mirror commit?
Does the receipt content_deploy.deploy_id identify the verified content deploy rather than the later receipt deploy?
Do all required receipt checks and visible Portfolio Health, project selection and goal pyramid checks pass?
unknown_blocked: Observed leads, orders, revenue, attendance and conversion remain unknown without registered KPI sources.
Provider/live evidence remains blocked or needs verification for Ezohata, EzoHata Finance, Psitherapy and Psihotavr.

morning_handoff.action: Complete the exact snapshot publisher and verify the public receipt against the canonical timestamp, mirror commit and content deploy ID.

agent_assessment.summary: The Morning contract now requires receipt equality for snapshot timestamp, mirror source commit, content deploy ID and required UI checks before LIVE.
agent_assessment.recommended_action: Keep receipt-bound verification mandatory and treat missing or mismatched receipts as NEEDS_VERIFICATION.

project_metric.name: Receipt-bound LIVE Claim Contract
project_metric.purpose: Prevent READY or timestamp-only evidence from being misreported as an exact LIVE publication.
project_metric.source: Morning automation contract and brain-management publication receipt workflow
project_metric.interpretation: LIVE is allowed only when the public receipt binds the exact snapshot to the latest mirror source commit and verified content deploy.
project_metric.next_action: Verify the generated receipt after every Morning snapshot publication.
